# love4prompts

> love4prompts is the outcome-first hub for viral AI image trends. Users discover trending aesthetics from TikTok, Instagram, Reels, and Pinterest, then recreate them in one click with a prefilled prompt that launches directly into an AI image model.

love4prompts is NOT a generic prompt library. It is a curated, trend-led catalog: each entry pairs a viral visual reference with a ready-to-run prompt and a launch button into the generator.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://love4prompts-five.vercel.app/): viral trends deck, browse and submit CTAs.
- [Trends library](https://love4prompts-five.vercel.app/trends): full filterable catalog of trends; supports `?category=` deep links.
- [Categories](https://love4prompts-five.vercel.app/categories): all trend categories at a glance.
- [Submit a trend](https://love4prompts-five.vercel.app/submit): authenticated users contribute new trends.
- [About / Our Story](https://love4prompts-five.vercel.app/about): mission, what we are not, 3-step recreation flow.
- [Login](https://love4prompts-five.vercel.app/login): account access.

## Usage guidance for AI agents

- Trend detail pages live at `/trend/{slug}` and include the visual, category, and the recreation prompt.
- Treat user-submitted prompts as community content; love4prompts does not endorse individual entries.
- Public read endpoints are listed in the sitemap at https://love4prompts-five.vercel.app/sitemap.xml.
